items.question: Why intended start time?
items.answer: Because closed-loop generators omit requests during stalls, so latency is measured from the intended start time.

items.question: Why intended start time?
items.answer: Use the average latency from the intended start time; stalls do not matter.

items.question: Why intended start time?
items.answer: Stalls hide latency.

items.question: How do retries double charge?
